messages.content:
下面给你一套「可直接复制」的提示词（含 MJ / SDXL 两版），用来生成与你参考图同风格的画面：暖米色极简科普海报、右侧女性居家办公焦虑、左侧留白排版、底部前后对比小图 + 音钵元素。  
（文字内容建议后期排版加上去，生成时用“无文字/无logo”更稳）

---

## 1) Midjourney 提示词（主图海报风）
**Prompt：**
> minimalist wellness infographic poster, warm beige and cream color palette, soft sunlight indoor scene, right side: stressed young asian woman working on laptop at home, hand on forehead, tired and anxious, white blouse, hair tied back, shallow depth of field, cozy bedroom/living room, bokeh lamp, gentle haze, left side large blank space for typography, clean editorial layout, modern health awareness poster style, premium commercial design, soft shadows, calm atmosphere, high-end photography, 4k, no text, no watermark, no logo

**参数建议：**
- `--ar 4:5 --v 6 --style raw --s 150`
- 如果想更像“版式海报”：`--ar 3:4` 也可

---

## 2) Midjourney 提示词（加“底部对比小图 + 音钵”版）
> same scene and layout, add bottom section: two small rectangular photos side-by-side (left: stressed, right: relaxed), a simple circular arrow icon between them, bottom right: brass singing bowl with wooden mallet on table, consistent warm beige tones, clean grid layout, lots of whitespace for copy, modern chinese social media health poster aesthetic, no text, no watermark, no logo

参数同上。

---

## 3) SDXL 提示词（更可控的商业海报摄影风）
**Positive prompt：**
> warm beige minimalist infographic poster background, soft daylight, indoor home office, right composition: stressed young asian woman, white blouse, ponytail, sitting at desk using laptop, hand touching forehead, anxious fatigue expression, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh lamp in background, gentle haze, premium commercial lifestyle photography, clean editorial layout, large empty space on the left for text, subtle rounded rectangles UI blocks, bottom area reserved for before-after comparison thumbnails, bottom right brass singing bowl and wooden mallet, calm wellness aesthetics, high quality, realistic

**Negative prompt：**
> text, words, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, bad hands, deformed face, lowres, blurry, overexposed, harsh contrast, cluttered background, messy desk, posterized, cartoon, anime

**推荐参数：**
- 尺寸：`832x1024` 或 `1024x1365`（接近 4:5）
- Steps：30-40；CFG：5-7；Sampler：DPM++ 2M Karras
- 需要更“留白”：把“large empty space on the left”再强调一次

---

## 4) 生成后快速“对齐参考图”的小改动词
- 更暖更柔：`soft warm tone, cream haze, low contrast`
- 更像科普海报：`infographic layout, rounded cards, grid system, editorial design`
- 更生活方式摄影：`commercial lifestyle photography, natural light`
- 想要右侧人物更靠边：`subject on right third, left side whitespace`

---

如果你告诉我你用的是 **Midjourney / SD / 可灵 / 即梦** 里的哪一个工具，我可以把提示词再按该平台的最佳写法（含参数、分层、权重）精确改到“更接近一比一版式”。
